description: This Java class implements a Spring Security UserDetailsService that loads user details from a database via UserRepository and maps them using UserDetailsMapper. It is used for authentication purposes to retrieve user information based on username (email).

classes.name: DatabaseUserDetailsService
classes.description: A service class that loads user details from the database for authentication.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads a user by email as username; throws UsernameNotFoundException if user not found.
